lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately seven vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, with vertical clusters containing between four and six spots per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a rectangular grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity light on the upper edges and distinct shadows beneath.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately six distinct high-luminance spots distributed primarily across the basal and central regions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple remora fish (family Echeneidae) swimming in close proximity to the pectoral fin and ventral surface of the shark.
